text: Don’t: Never place feature strips or new modules above the homepage hero banner. They sit in the lobby as a block, like the casino content rows.
Do: Keep new UI simple, polished and compact: when a composition feels busy, remove elements before adding any.
Don’t: Don’t give a status/tracker card a full-width, tall row on desktop. Use a compact card (e.g. a slim inline stepper) sized to its content.
Don’t: Don’t crowd mobile cards with several text buttons. One primary action at most; secondary actions like Notify me or Copy become icon buttons.

Do: For layouts peers already do well (tournaments, leaderboards, lobbies), study the best peer compositions in Mobbin and the research folder first, and aim for one clear focal item with a calm hierarchy.
